name: rydr-functions
description: Rydr Cloud Functions backend — Vehicle Library System (VIN decoding + managed vehicle image library). Shared backend layer called by RydrDriver, RydrPlayground, and Mission Control.

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.test: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project demo-rydr-scheduled-rides --only firestore "node --test test/firebase-foundation.test.js"
